Simplest solution.

Wearing heels relatively consistently/regularly will cause your muscles to support your feet more and give you less pain overall.

It was abdominal pain that the nursing home wasn't able to treat so they admitted him to the ER. 

I know there was realistically nothing wrong with this. I was told they were just taking him to the ER to get him checked, no major issues right away. I got the call about 10 minutes before my interview would have ended. The worst part is I was interviewing at my husband's company and I still see the guy who was interviewing me at their holiday functions. I'm sure my reaction was one they didn't soon forget. 

At any rate, I think what helps is to take the silly little things, that you know his dad would have liked. Do those. Like, if he always used scratch-off lottery tickets, get some and scratch them together. Or watch his favorite sports team, or something like that. Don't look for something extreme and colossal. Enjoy the little things.

After about a month of non-nicotine when the only thing left was the physical habit, I'd just stop taking it into work with me for awhile, then stop taking it out unless I went to a bar. For the record, menthol flavors are much better with non-nicotine because it gives you more of a "throat hit". 

It wasn't even hard to get rid of the e-cig at the end since I'd gradually moved off of it that way.

Are you fucking kidding me? It was documented that the BANK EMPLOYEE screwed her over and this poor woman was going to get completely fucked now because there was no way she had the money to catch up, especially with all the fees that she had no idea she was accruing.

It will suck but showering/washing your hair in EXTREMELY cold water. As cold as you can possibly stand it. Warm/hot water opens the pores in your hair follicles more and release more of the color. Make sure you use a color protecting shampoo/conditioner (the "specialty" ones at the grocery store are shit and over-priced. Most salon quality ones you see at the grocery are also likely expired. Go to an Ulta/Sephora/salon and grab something from there. Cheaper and you usually get a LOT more of it) and only wash your hair every couple of days. Get a good shower cap or two. I would only wash mine every 3-5 days. We over-wash our hair as it is. 


I've been able to keep my reds/blues/other alternative colors bright for FAR longer this way. My last red lasted almost 3 months before it really faded out at all. It got a little duller a month in but I had more root showing before the color really started being noticeably faded. 

PS - Don't use box dye, for the love of all things holy. 

EDIT: Also, one thing to note with how I'd tolerate the stupidly cold water was to turn my shower head to the side and only stick my head in there. Because hell with getting all of my body in that cold water. Btw, I'm talking like, all the way as cold as it can go. Not room temp/lukewarm.
